phases.official_behavior: The three-page return is editable subject to ATC, quarter, amended-return, and deduction-method dependencies. Validate is enabled; Print and Submit / Final Copy are disabled.
Save runs only initialValidateBeforeSave, serializes frmMain in DOM order, updates the synthetic profile, and leaves the return editable.
After the ordered Validate body passes, controls are disabled and Edit, Print, and Submit / Final Copy are enabled.
Submit / Final Copy checks existing versions/final state and asks for Internet/email submission confirmation.
When the connection probe fails after confirmation, txtFinalFlag becomes 3 and saveEncryptedProfile writes/encrypts an IAF_RDO_Copy artifact.
Enrollment/credential state is collected, an encrypted copy is created, and RenameAndSendFile is invoked for 1702Qv2018C.
Transport return code 0 sets txtFinalFlag to 1, updates the save, shows submission success, and opens payment options.
A nonzero transport code or exception sets txtFinalFlag to 2, updates the save, and shows the generic transmission failure message.

transitions.guard: A quarter is selected; TIN parts and branch are nonblank; RDO is nonblank; taxpayer name is nonblank.
side_effects: Serializes both DOM elements sharing frm1702q:txtTelNum.

transitions.guard: All reachable ordered Validate rules pass. With no quarter selected, Validate instead returns silently and remains in edit state.
side_effects: Enables Edit, Print, and Submit / Final Copy.
Disables Print and Submit / Final Copy until revalidation.

transitions.guard: No conflicting finalized non-amended return/version and txtFinalFlag is not direct resend state 2.

side_effects: Shows debug-like saveEncryptedProfile alerts containing the selected filename branch.

transitions.guard: checkNetConnection() returns true and enrollment/credential confirmation proceeds.
side_effects: Sets prior offline flag 3 to retry flag 2, otherwise resets to 0.

prerequisites: Only the first three quarters are fileable on 1702Q.
The official help requires filing with or without payment within 60 days after each of the first three taxable-year quarters.
Submit / Final Copy is enabled only after successful Validate, but final-copy serialization itself reuses the narrower Save preflight.
The UI stores a two-digit year and reconstructs it as 2000 plus that value.

filing_deadlines.due_date_rule: Within 60 days following the close of the first quarter of the taxable year, subject to applicable electronic-filing issuances.
Within 60 days following the close of the second quarter of the taxable year, subject to applicable electronic-filing issuances.
